decisionsTitle: «Direct pe lista de așteptare»: the Administrator vouches for the address at the entry, and the row goes through the allocator at once — in one press from the waiting list itself
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-30,** four days after «Lista internă de așteptare» (§854): «Ar trebui să pot adăuga pe cineva pe lista de așteptare direct, nu neapărat pe cea internă.» Until now the only way onto the official waiting list was the person's own click: the staff entry (BR-REQ-037-05) wrote a `PENDING_EMAIL_CONFIRMATION` row and emailed the link, and the row joined the line only when the link was pressed — so the person the club wrote down after a telephone call or a contact-form message stood nowhere until they found the email, and the internal list was the only place the club could put them at once.

**Decision.** The staff entry (`/admin/registrations/new`) gets a second tick beside the desk's fast track, the Administrator's alone (`canManageRegistrations`, asserted by `createRegistrationByStaff`; the Organizer and the volunteer do not see it, and a forged box is refused before anything is written): «Direct pe lista de așteptare: garantez eu adresa, fără emailul de confirmare.» With it, `submitRegistration` (`origin.addressVouched`) writes the desk's vouching on the new row — `email_confirmed_at` and `email_confirmed_by_staff_user_id`, never the participant's own `email_verified_at`, word for word as the desk (§67) and «Dă-i un loc acum» (§637) write it — and sends the row through the one allocator in the entry's own transaction, under the same event lock: `WAITLISTED` at the back of the line when the event is full, `PENDING_DECLARATION` when a counted place is free, with the outcome's ordinary email («Ești pe lista de așteptare», or the declaration to sign, which starts the hold, §513) and no verification email. A full line refuses the whole entry (§348) and nothing is written — one transaction, so no walk-in's half-state. The held place waits as «Dă-i un loc acum»'s does (`computeVouchedPlaceExpiry`: the window's deadline, or the start; capped by the start alone, never the close), because the person is not at the form reading an email; the public registration window is not consulted, as at the desk — the mode must still be INTERNAL, the event SCHEDULED and dated — but after the start the entry is refused (`VOUCHED_ENTRY_AFTER_START`, its own sentence): a remote act, so only the desk takes a person then, as «Dă-i un loc acum» rules. Two trail rows under the Administrator's id: `registration.created_by_staff` with the landed state and `addressVouched`, and the new `registration.address_vouched_on_entry` with `from` and `to` — never a name or an address. Under the fast track the tick is ignored: the paper confirmation vouches for the address in person already. From the internal list, «Trece pe lista oficială» opens the same form, so the tick works there too.

**One press, from the list itself.** Asked what was still missing, the owner chose «a short «Adaugă» form on the waiting-list panel — like «Adaugă pe lista internă»: name and email right in the panel, one press, no long form to scroll through». So «Adaugă pe lista de așteptare» (`WaitlistAddForm`, `addToWaitlistAction`) is drawn under the queue's line in «Coada de înscrieri» on the event's page and as its own panel on the event's registrations list, beside the internal list, to an Administrator alone: first name, last name, email, an optional internal note (§777, checked before anything is written and put on the registration after it) and the relay tick, which stays a tick — the rule of §33 is binding, not decorative. It posts the same staff entry with the vouching tick on; the person's emails leave in the backoffice's language, and the full form — every other answer, the person's own language — is one link away. The dialog names the email it sends (§384). The toast says where the row landed («Persoana e pe lista de așteptare», or «Era un loc liber: persoana l-a primit»), and the panel the press came from opens on the way back.

**What this is not.** Not a place ahead of anyone: the allocator's own order, the line served first (§615), no supplementary place (§642) — a free place is given only because it is free, exactly as the person's own click would have had it. Not a signature: the declaration stays the person's, online from the email or on paper at the desk (`AGENTS.md` §10.8, §15.11). Not silent: §854's refusal of a silent queue stands — the person asked (the relay tick), and gets the email their state earns, with its link to withdraw. Not the Organizer's: vouching for an address changes a registration, which the Organizer reads and does not change (§289), as with «Dă-i un loc acum».

**Refused.** A separate «Adaugă pe lista de așteptare» form on the registrations page — the staff entry already asks everything and keeps the duplicate, age and address rules; a second door would be a second allocator entrance to keep in step. A tick that waitlists a person while a place is free — a free place beside a waiting row is what `fillAvailableSpots` exists to prevent. The ordinary thirty-minute hold on a vouched free place — §637's argument applies unchanged.

**Consequences.** `registrations/service.ts` (`RegistrationOrigin.addressVouched`, `submitRegistration`'s `vouchAndAllocate` beside `holdVerification`, `allocateOrWaitlist`'s `vouched` deadline rule), `registrations/admin-service.ts` (`CreateRegistrationByStaffInput.vouchAddress`, the role assertion), `audit/repository.ts` (`registration.address_vouched_on_entry`), `admin/registrations/actions.ts`, `admin/registrations/new/page.tsx` (the tick), `registrations/ui/WaitlistAddForm.tsx` (new), `registrations/ui/QueuePanel.tsx` and the event page, the registrations list page (the panel), `messages/{ro,en}.json`; `AGENTS.md` §10.5 rule 3 and §15.11; CLAUDE.md's staff-verbs row. Tests: `integration/registrations/direct-waitlist-entry.test.ts` and `integration/registrations/waitlist-add-action.test.ts` (new), `unit/shared/confirmed-actions.test.ts`. No migration, no dependency, no new message type.
changelogLine: - **«Adaugă pe lista de așteptare», in one press** — on the event's queue panel and on the registrations list an Administrator types a name and an email and the person is on the official waiting list at once (or holds a place when one is free), with the ordinary email for that state and no confirmation link; the same entry is the tick «Direct pe lista de așteptare» on «Adaugă o înscriere». §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an Administrator entering a registration with «Direct pe lista de așteptare» ticked, when the entry is written, then the row carries the staff vouching for the address (`email_confirmed_by_staff_user_id`), goes through the ordinary allocator in the same transaction — `WAITLISTED` at the back of the line on a full event, `PENDING_DECLARATION` on a free counted place, never ahead of anyone and never a supplementary place — receives that state's ordinary email and no verification email, and is audited as `registration.address_vouched_on_entry`; a full line refuses the whole entry and writes nothing; an Organizer or a volunteer posting the tick is refused; under the fast track the tick is ignored; «Adaugă pe lista de așteptare» on the queue panel and the registrations list posts the same entry with the tick on, Administrator only, the relay tick still required (2026-10-30, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Adaugă pe lista de așteptare» in one press: the Administrator vouches for the address and the row joins the line or takes a free place at once
